description: This file implements RADIUS server handling within the hostapd project, including TLS event handling, user data management, RADIUS attribute parsing, and server setup and initialization.

methods.name: radius_tls_event
methods.description: Handles TLS events such as certificate verification, alerts, and peer certificate info, logging relevant messages.

methods.name: radius_userdata_init
methods.description: Initializes radius user data structures, including kvlist and AVL tree.

methods.name: radius_userdata_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with radius user data, including kvlist and AVL tree.

methods.name: radius_userdata_load
methods.description: Loads user data from JSON blob into radius user data structures.

methods.name: load_userfile
methods.description: Loads and parses user data file, updating phase1 and phase2 user data.

methods.name: radius_user_get
methods.description: Retrieves user data by name, supporting wildcards and caching.

methods.name: radius_get_eap_user
methods.description: Retrieves EAP user info based on identity, supporting phase 1 and phase 2.

methods.name: radius_setup
methods.description: Initializes the radius server, TLS context, and EAP configuration.

methods.name: radius_init
methods.description: Initializes radius server state and user data.

methods.name: radius_deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes radius server and cleans up resources.

methods.name: radius_main
methods.description: Main entry point for radius server, parsing command-line options, initializing, and running event loop.
